title: CISA flags exploitation of a 2023 flaw in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series systems CISA has added a 2023 Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series flaw to its list

CISA flags exploitation of a 2023 flaw in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series systems CISA has added a 2023 Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series flaw to its list
